title: Edit Distance
summary: Find the minimum number of single-character insertions, deletions, and replacements needed to transform word1 into word2.

contractDetails.constraints: Both strings have lengths 0–500 and contain lowercase English letters.

statement: Find the minimum number of single-character insertions, deletions, and replacements needed to transform word1 into word2. Each operation costs one.
constraints: Both strings have lengths 0–500 and contain lowercase English letters.
hints: Conceptual: Transforming a string to empty requires one deletion per character.
Directional: Compare the possible operations at the ends of two prefixes.
Implementation: Initialize the empty-prefix states. For unequal final letters, add one to the cheapest deletion, insertion, or replacement state.
complexityAnalysis: O(mn + m + n) time and O(n) space.
